game.rules:
**The following is a heavily abridged summary of the rules. To view the full rules, please click [here.](https://www.minecraftspeedrunning.com/public-resources/rules) This is only intended to be a user-friendly version of the rules which highlights key details and rules which must be followed. In addition to reading these rules, it is highly recommended to watch the [official submission guide](https://youtu.be/z2n2fCV1GY0) when submitting runs.**

# **Important Reminders**

**The F3 screen must be shown in the video of the run for all runs.**

- You still need to show F3 after the run is over even if you don’t use it in the run. (such as No F3 categories)
- When you show the F3 screen, make sure all parts are legible and unobscured.

**All runs must be submitted with a video.**

- The video must be permanent and viewable. (no Twitch VODs or private videos)

**You must include the world seed in your submission description.**

**Runs must include a video that shows all screens of creating the world, followed by the loading square.**

- For vanilla runs, you must show the World List and Create New World screens. If the run is set seed, you must also show the Seed Input screen.
- For runs that use the Atum mod, the video must show part of the prior run and the world generation loading square. 
- If you are using the mods Atum and SpeedrunIGT, and the SpeedrunIGT timer is visible upon the run’s start, and the F3 screen is opened and visible before exiting the world, the video does not need to include any world generation.

**Recreate is banned in versions 1.16+ for set seed runs.**

# **Mod Rules**

**Fabric API is banned.**

- This is a separate .jar file and not the Fabric Loader itself.

**Optifine is banned for 1.15+.**

- If you choose to use Optifine in pre-1.15, you may only do so with particular settings. These settings can be found in [A.8.1](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L687) of the full rules. 

**Fabric Loader is the only allowed mod loader. Do not use Forge or anything else.**

**There are only a few mods that you are allowed to use, which can be found here ([https://mods.tildejustin.dev/](https://mods.tildejustin.dev/)).**

- We recommend using SpeedrunIGT for ease of verification.

# **General Speedrun Rules**

**Keep the default settings of world generation.**

- You can only change the world name, difficulty (except for Peaceful), or choosing hardcore instead of survival.

**Do not edit the game’s files.**

- However, in the options.txt file, gamma may be edited up to 5.0.
- A launcher which has been verified to leave the game unmodified must be used. This includes:
  - The vanilla Minecraft launcher
  - MultiMC
  - Prism Launcher

**Do not use commands during the run.**

**Do not use Peaceful difficulty during the run.**

**The way runs are timed is either by world load or by first input, depending upon the category.**

**Runs must not intend to be as slow as possible (no “slowruns”).**

# **Submission Rules**

**Mark your run as F3 if it uses the F3 screen during the run, or any feature which is triggered by an F3 hotkey (such as F3+B hitboxes, F3+H advanced tooltips or F3+Esc pausing).**

**Mark your run’s difficulty as the lowest difficulty played during the run.**

**Mark the mods section of your run in accordance with the mods you used at any point during the run.**

- If no mods are used, choose Vanilla.
- If just Optifine (not Optifabric) is used, choose Optifine.
- If anything else (including Optifabric, Fabric Loader) is used, choose Modded.

# **Resource Pack Rules**

**You are only allowed to use a few resource packs. If you want to be safe, just use the vanilla resource pack.**

- You can use any vanilla resource packs, including the default pack, Programmer Art, and High Contrast packs.
- Detailed resource pack rules can be found in section A.4 of the full rules.
- If you use a non-vanilla resource pack, include a link to it in the speedrun.com run’s description.

# **Additional Proof**

**When submitting additional proof, please use the official Google form (**[https://forms.gle/v7oPXfjfi7553jkp7](https://forms.gle/v7oPXfjfi7553jkp7)**).**

**Additional proof is only required for achieving certain times in certain categories (see category rules to see if you need to). Regardless, when submitting a run, you agree to provide extra proof if asked by moderators. Refusal may lead to rejection.**

**If you are unsure how to submit certain pieces of additional proof, please follow the [tutorial](https://youtu.be/z2n2fCV1GY0) on submitting additional proof.**

# **External Tool Rules**

**SeedQueue, a mod that simulates multi-instance, where multiple instances of Minecraft are used to reset faster, is recommended in versions where it is available.**

- If you want to use multiple instances, such as in versions where SeedQueue is not available, please read the detailed multiple instance rules in section A.9 of the full rules.

**If you open multiple instances of Minecraft, they must each be in unique directories (separate .minecraft folders).**

**Do not use any macros in-game except for resize macros.**

- Any macros which change the screen size to within the monitor bounds may be used.
- Only one macro may make the game window larger than the monitor size, like a zoom macro for measuring Eyes of Ender. (intended to replace above rule)

**You may remap keys using external programs (like AutoHotkey), but it must be a one-to-one remap.**

- For instance, Shift+F3 cannot be rebound to a singular key.
- You may not rebind anything to the scrolling action of the scroll wheel.

**Physical reference sheets may be used, as well as four-function calculators. A reference sheet of any size not based on F3 information may be used.**

- For instance, stronghold ring locations, sheets/graphs of structure regions, and villager trading tables may be used.

**Other reference sheets and external tools must be specifically approved to be used as listed in [A.11.6 and A.11.7](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L827) of the full rules.**

**Specifically approved external tools may be used, as listed in [A.11.7](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L835) of the full rules. All other external tools may not be used.**

- Ninjabrain Bot for measuring Eyes of Ender is allowed.

# **Random Seed Rules**

**You are required to use a random seed (leave the seed input box blank).**

**You may not learn the seed during the run.**

- Do not do /seed until the run is over.
- Do not attempt to crack the world seed.
- After the run you should do /seed in order to include the seed in your run submission.
- Do not use F3 in pre-1.3 (it shows the seed).

# **Set Seed Rules**

**Recreate is banned in versions 1.16+.**

**You are required to set a world seed.**

# **Glitchless Rules**

**Do not save and quit or leave the game during the run.**

- You can save and quit accidentally or to resolve a bug. See the detailed rules on using Save and Quit in glitchless runs to see under what conditions it is allowed in D.1.3 of the full rules.

**A few additional techniques can be used in glitchless runs.**

- These include double-eating and Eliotex sprinting. See the detailed rules on what techniques are and aren’t allowed for glitchless runs in D.1.1 and D.1.2 of the full rules.

**SSG and RSG stand for “Set Seed Glitchless” and “Random Seed Glitchless” respectively, so they must follow the rules above.**

# **Glitched Rules**

**Glitched runs must use at least one glitch.**

- In External categories, you may Save and Quit and crash the game.

**It is highly recommended to use SpeedrunIGT in glitched categories, going to Timer, and setting the Autosave Interval to Ticks.**

**All gameplay segments are timed in glitched runs.**

**Any categories without the word “Glitchless” are glitched. This includes Any%, SS, and RS.**

# **Co-op Rules**

**Use either a dedicated** **server or Open to LAN.**

**Your server cannot use any mods that are banned, even if there are no plugins.**

- Do not use Paper, Spigot, CraftBukkit, or Bungeecord.

**You can use /difficulty to change the difficulty.**

- Do not change the difficulty in options, as it will enable peaceful momentarily.
- You must enable cheats to do this.

**If all players wait until everyone has joined, one person can do /time set 0, which will start the run’s timer.**

- You must enable cheats to do this.
- Do not use /time set 0 more than once.

**The first person to join the server, the person to complete the run, and anyone with cheats enabled must record their perspectives. When submitting your run, include these videos in the speedrun.com run description.**

- It is helpful to have all players submit a video, but only the ones above are required to.

**If more than 16 players are running, choose 16 players while submitting, input the names of 15 of the players, and then list “+others” for the 16th slot. Include the name of all other players not listed in the description of the speedrun.com submission.**

# **Structures/No Structures Rules**

**A structure is anything that requires Generate Structures: On to generate. (such as a Village, Nether Fortress, Mineshaft).**

- Dungeons are also considered a structure.
- See the full list of structures in [G.1.1](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L1081) of the full rules.

**A category marked ‘Structures’ must use at least one structure.**

**A category marked ‘No Structures’ cannot use any structures.**

- You may choose Generate Structures: Off, or keep them on but do not interact with them.

relatedGames.rules:
**REMINDERS:**

- Optifine is banned for 1.15+
- Fabric API is banned
- You must show the F3 menu before or after the run, and should show /seed as well
    - When showing F3, make sure that no part is covered by an overlay
- You must include the world seed in your submission description
- If you want to be safe, just use the vanilla resource pack
- Any program or macro which screen reads is not allowed, and any attempt to get around this rule will not be tolerated (i.e. taking a screenshot and a program reading from that, etc. would not be allowed)
- For runners utilizing the Atum mod, the "Stop resets and quit" button within the options menu must be shown at least once during the run, otherwise, logs for the PB session must be provided
- It is highly recommended to use SpeedRunIGT as it is the most accurate
    - Please set timing to first input if the category states as such
    - Please show the 3 digits of the timer during the run
    - If applicable, please use the timer extension corresponding to the category you are playing

**General Speedrun Rules**

- Runs must be done in Survival or Hardcore worlds
- World generation settings must be default
    - No cheats
    - No bonus chest
    - World Type: Default, unless specified otherwise
    - Only the default Data Pack
    - Default Game Rules
- Do not use Peaceful difficulty
- Use an official release of the game. No alpha, beta, snapshots, etc.
    - No versions released before 1.0
    - No snapshots
    - No prereleases
    - No release candidates
    - No April Fool’s updates
- Do not alter options.txt to circumvent the bounds on them set by the game with the following exceptions:
    - Gamma, which can be set up to 5.0
    - Difficulty
    - syncChunkWrites
- Use only one world
- If you open multiple instances of Minecraft, they must each be in unique directories so they cannot influence each other in any way.
    - Each instance must be shown in recording. If official submitted video does not have each instance being shown, a separate video must ALSO be submitted showing each instance
    - Playing the game in any other instance invalidates the current run
    - All instances must have the percentage of the chunkmap legible, i.e. able to be read, as a rule of thumb for the minimum resolution/bitrate required. Should you choose to have a zoomed in capture of the loading square (alongside the full instance capture), both the center of the screen and the position the loading square jumps to during the WorldPreview mod must be zoomed in and recorded to capture the full loading screen
- Do not use console commands
- You may read from the statistics and advancements files
- Super Secret Settings is not allowed

**Macro and Rebind Rules**

- In game macros may not be used, with the following exceptions:
    - Macros which resize the game window are allowed, but are restricted to switching between only 2 resolutions during the run
    - Macros may be used between runs in order to reset worlds. We recommend a delay of at least 70ms between inputs to ensure all show up on video. Reset macros may resize the window before the run begins
    - Any reset macros must be triggered manually. They cannot look at the game files or screen read in order to determine whether to reset
    - Any attempt to get around this rule by automating any in game functions such as crafting will result in your run being rejected
- Using the clipboard during a run to paste text in the game is allowed. However, modifying the content of your clipboard during the run is not allowed, except if it happens directly in the game (for exemple with F3 C, F3 I, or by copying text from books or chat)
- You may remap keys using external programs, but
    - Each game input may have only one key, and each key may cause only one game input
    - F3 shortcuts (such as F3+c, shift+F3, etc.) can't be bound to a single button
    - Inputs must be buttons - no scrolling the scroll-wheel or similar
    - Rebinding "Attack/Destroy" or "Use Item/Place Block" to a keyboard button is not allowed

**Submission Rules**

**Video Rules**

- You must include a video of your run, preferably uploaded to Youtube
- Start the video before opening the Create World screen
- Each screen in world creation must be shown
- End the video after the run is completed
- The F3 menu must be shown during or immediately after the run
- The video must not be private
- The video must not be temporary (such as Twitch past broadcasts)
- Do not interlace the video through editing

**Speedrun.com Submission Rules**

- Include your run’s seed in the submission description for all categories except Perfect Seed Glitchless.
- Remember not to check the seed until after the run is over in Random Seed categories
- Mark your run as “F3” if you used the F3 menu, the Optifine FPS display, or any F3 hotkey
- If you change the difficulty mid-run, set the "difficulty" variable to the lowest difficulty used during the run

**If you submit a run, you are agreeing to send the game moderators extra proof (in particular but not limited to unedited local recordings of attempts and world save files) upon request. Refusal to comply may result in rejection. World files, logs, etc. are always appreciated to be linked in the run description, but not required unless specified for category rules or if requested by the moderation team. See https://bit.ly/mcsrevidence for more details.**

You may open a ticket in the MC_JUICE discord server to submit world files, VODs, etc.

**Resource Pack Rules**

- Almost all resource packs are not allowed
- If you would like to use a resource pack different from the built-in resource packs, please read the detailed rules: https://bit.ly/extrarules

**Mod Rules**

- Optifine is allowed for versions 1.0 through 1.14
    - If you use Optifine, please read the detailed mod rules at https://bit.ly/extrarules
- Fabric Loader is the only allowed mod loader
    - Legacy Fabric Loader is allowed for versions 1.0 through 1.13
    - Fabric Loader is allowed for versions 1.14+
- Any mods specified in the official legal mods repository are also allowed. The legal mods repository can be found here: https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/legal-mods
    - Please note the conditions stated in the repository, such as set seed only mods and accessibility mods.
    - To easily download the mods for a specific version, please refer to https://redlime.github.io/MCSRMods

Accessibility Mods

- You may use extra-options or motioNO in versions 1.14+

In addition to client mods, the only mods allowed for **servers** are the speedrunning-approved mods running on a Fabric server, such as Lithium, Phosphor, and Krypton. This means **no Paper, Spigot, Bungeecord, Bukkit, etc**, even if you don't have any mods or plugins enabled.

**External Resources Rules**

Only resources which are outside your game that are listed here are allowed to be utilized:

- Ninjabrain-bot [Ninjabrain1] (up to v1.4.1)
- StrongholdNotCalculator [pjagada] (up to v2.0)
- PerfectTravelBot [FourGoesFast] (up to v1.0.0)
- DivineHeatmapGenerator [mtjb49] (up to v1.1-alpha)
- ContariaCalc [KingContaria] (up to v1.1.7.1)
- SFCalc [ParaFraser] (up to v1.1) **Superflat only**
- Four function calculators
- Any sheets physically printed out
- Reference Sheets:
    - Any reference which is a subset of a legal reference is allowed.
    - Any reference which references information not based on data from the F3 menu is unilaterally allowed, i.e. stronghold rings, all structure regions sheets/graphs, villager trading tables, etc.
    - Four's perfect travel spreadsheet, axis calculated, divine fossil sheet, animal divine sheet, tree divine sheet, ravine/air cave/nether cave divine sheet, water cave divine sheet, and nether portal orientation divine sheet are allowed. Any other references which do not fall in the above categories are illegal.
- If you use any resources not explicitly allowed by these rules, your run may be rejected
- Only position, angle, and dimension (notably, not biome) are allowed to be used for resources that utilize F3 information
- Any code-based tool must be on a publicly accessible repository, i.e. Github
- Links to explicitly allowed resources can be found on the extended rules document at http://bombch.us/DOOK

**Seed Rules**

**Set Seed Rules**

- You must use a seed to generate the world you run on
- You cannot use the recreate world button to generate worlds in versions 1.16 and above. For any version prior to 1.16, you may use the recreate world button.
- You may also alternatively use the Atum mod to reset worlds.
- For runners utilizing the Atum mod, the "Stop resets and quit" button within the options menu must be shown at least once during the run, otherwise, logs for the PB session must be provided.

**Random Seed Rules**

- You are required to use a random seed
- The seed input box must be left completely blank
- You may not learn the seed during the run
    - Do not do /seed
    - If on a version before 1.3, do not use the F3 menu (it shows the seed)
    - Do not reverse engineer the seed
- After the run you should do /seed in order to include the seed in your run submission

**Glitchless Rules**

- All categories are glitchless.
- For any categories that do not explicitly allow segmentation, if the world is quit for any reason other than working around a bug/glitch, the run will be rejected without exception.
- Do not use any glitches
- Do not abuse Save and Quit

**Banned techniques include:**

- Duplication glitches
- Save and Quit invulnerability abuse
- X-Ray glitches

**The following is a heavily abridged summary of the rules. To view the full rules, please click [here.](https://www.minecraftspeedrunning.com/public-resources/rules) This is only intended to be a user-friendly version of the rules which highlights key details and rules which must be followed. In addition to reading these rules, it is highly recommended to watch the [official submission guide](https://youtu.be/z2n2fCV1GY0) when submitting runs.**

# **Important Reminders**

**The F3 screen must be shown in the video of the run for all runs.**

- You still need to show F3 after the run is over even if you don’t use it in the run. (such as No F3 categories)
- When you show the F3 screen, make sure all parts are legible and unobscured.

**All runs must be submitted with a video.**

- The video must be permanent and viewable. (no Twitch VODs or private videos)

**You must include the world seed in your submission description.**

**Runs must include a video that shows all screens of creating the world, followed by the loading square.**

- For vanilla runs, you must show the World List and Create New World screens. If the run is set seed, you must also show the Seed Input screen.
- For runs that use the Atum mod, the video must show part of the prior run and the world generation loading square. 
- If you are using the mods Atum and SpeedrunIGT, and the SpeedrunIGT timer is visible upon the run’s start, and the F3 screen is opened and visible before exiting the world, the video does not need to include any world generation.

**Recreate is banned in versions 1.16+ for set seed runs.**

# **Mod Rules**

**Fabric API is banned.**

- This is a separate .jar file and not the Fabric Loader itself.

**Optifine is banned for 1.15+.**

- If you choose to use Optifine in pre-1.15, you may only do so with particular settings. These settings can be found in [A.8.1](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L687) of the full rules. 

**Fabric Loader is the only allowed mod loader. Do not use Forge or anything else.**

**There are only a few mods that you are allowed to use, which can be found here ([https://mods.tildejustin.dev/](https://mods.tildejustin.dev/)).**

- We recommend using SpeedrunIGT for ease of verification.

# **General Speedrun Rules**

**Keep the default settings of world generation.**

- You can only change the world name, difficulty (except for Peaceful), or choosing hardcore instead of survival.

**Do not edit the game’s files.**

- However, in the options.txt file, gamma may be edited up to 5.0.
- A launcher which has been verified to leave the game unmodified must be used. This includes:
  - The vanilla Minecraft launcher
  - MultiMC
  - Prism Launcher

**Do not use commands during the run.**

**Do not use Peaceful difficulty during the run.**

**The way runs are timed is either by world load or by first input, depending upon the category.**

**Runs must not intend to be as slow as possible (no “slowruns”).**

# **Submission Rules**

**Mark your run as F3 if it uses the F3 screen during the run, or any feature which is triggered by an F3 hotkey (such as F3+B hitboxes, F3+H advanced tooltips or F3+Esc pausing).**

**Mark your run’s difficulty as the lowest difficulty played during the run.**

**Mark the mods section of your run in accordance with the mods you used at any point during the run.**

- If no mods are used, choose Vanilla.
- If just Optifine (not Optifabric) is used, choose Optifine.
- If anything else (including Optifabric, Fabric Loader) is used, choose Modded.

# **Resource Pack Rules**

**You are only allowed to use a few resource packs. If you want to be safe, just use the vanilla resource pack.**

- You can use any vanilla resource packs, including the default pack, Programmer Art, and High Contrast packs.
- Detailed resource pack rules can be found in section A.4 of the full rules.
- If you use a non-vanilla resource pack, include a link to it in the speedrun.com run’s description.

# **Additional Proof**

**When submitting additional proof, please use the official Google form (**[https://forms.gle/v7oPXfjfi7553jkp7](https://forms.gle/v7oPXfjfi7553jkp7)**).**

**Additional proof is only required for achieving certain times in certain categories (see category rules to see if you need to). Regardless, when submitting a run, you agree to provide extra proof if asked by moderators. Refusal may lead to rejection.**

**If you are unsure how to submit certain pieces of additional proof, please follow the [tutorial](https://youtu.be/z2n2fCV1GY0) on submitting additional proof.**

# **External Tool Rules**

**SeedQueue, a mod that simulates multi-instance, where multiple instances of Minecraft are used to reset faster, is recommended in versions where it is available.**

- If you want to use multiple instances, such as in versions where SeedQueue is not available, please read the detailed multiple instance rules in section A.9 of the full rules.

**If you open multiple instances of Minecraft, they must each be in unique directories (separate .minecraft folders).**

**Do not use any macros in-game except for resize macros.**

- Any macros which change the screen size to within the monitor bounds may be used.
- Only one macro may make the game window larger than the monitor size, like a zoom macro for measuring Eyes of Ender. (intended to replace above rule)

**You may remap keys using external programs (like AutoHotkey), but it must be a one-to-one remap.**

- For instance, Shift+F3 cannot be rebound to a singular key.
- You may not rebind anything to the scrolling action of the scroll wheel.

**Physical reference sheets may be used, as well as four-function calculators. A reference sheet of any size not based on F3 information may be used.**

- For instance, stronghold ring locations, sheets/graphs of structure regions, and villager trading tables may be used.

**Other reference sheets and external tools must be specifically approved to be used as listed in [A.11.6 and A.11.7](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L827) of the full rules.**

**Specifically approved external tools may be used, as listed in [A.11.7](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L835) of the full rules. All other external tools may not be used.**

- Ninjabrain Bot for measuring Eyes of Ender is allowed.

# **Random Seed Rules**

**You are required to use a random seed (leave the seed input box blank).**

**You may not learn the seed during the run.**

- Do not do /seed until the run is over.
- Do not attempt to crack the world seed.
- After the run you should do /seed in order to include the seed in your run submission.
- Do not use F3 in pre-1.3 (it shows the seed).

# **Set Seed Rules**

**Recreate is banned in versions 1.16+.**

**You are required to set a world seed.**

# **Glitchless Rules**

**Do not save and quit or leave the game during the run.**

- You can save and quit accidentally or to resolve a bug. See the detailed rules on using Save and Quit in glitchless runs to see under what conditions it is allowed in D.1.3 of the full rules.

**A few additional techniques can be used in glitchless runs.**

- These include double-eating and Eliotex sprinting. See the detailed rules on what techniques are and aren’t allowed for glitchless runs in D.1.1 and D.1.2 of the full rules.

**SSG and RSG stand for “Set Seed Glitchless” and “Random Seed Glitchless” respectively, so they must follow the rules above.**

# **Glitched Rules**

**Glitched runs must use at least one glitch.**

- In External categories, you may Save and Quit and crash the game.

**It is highly recommended to use SpeedrunIGT in glitched categories, going to Timer, and setting the Autosave Interval to Ticks.**

**All gameplay segments are timed in glitched runs.**

**Any categories without the word “Glitchless” are glitched. This includes Any%, SS, and RS.**

# **Co-op Rules**

**Use either a dedicated** **server or Open to LAN.**

**Your server cannot use any mods that are banned, even if there are no plugins.**

- Do not use Paper, Spigot, CraftBukkit, or Bungeecord.

**You can use /difficulty to change the difficulty.**

- Do not change the difficulty in options, as it will enable peaceful momentarily.
- You must enable cheats to do this.

**If all players wait until everyone has joined, one person can do /time set 0, which will start the run’s timer.**

- You must enable cheats to do this.
- Do not use /time set 0 more than once.

**The first person to join the server, the person to complete the run, and anyone with cheats enabled must record their perspectives. When submitting your run, include these videos in the speedrun.com run description.**

- It is helpful to have all players submit a video, but only the ones above are required to.

**If more than 16 players are running, choose 16 players while submitting, input the names of 15 of the players, and then list “+others” for the 16th slot. Include the name of all other players not listed in the description of the speedrun.com submission.**

# **Structures/No Structures Rules**

**A structure is anything that requires Generate Structures: On to generate. (such as a Village, Nether Fortress, Mineshaft).**

- Dungeons are also considered a structure.
- See the full list of structures in [G.1.1](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L1081) of the full rules.

**A category marked ‘Structures’ must use at least one structure.**

**A category marked ‘No Structures’ cannot use any structures.**

- You may choose Generate Structures: Off, or keep them on but do not interact with them.

**The following is a heavily abridged summary of the rules. To view the full rules, please click [here.](https://www.minecraftspeedrunning.com/public-resources/rules) This is only intended to be a user-friendly version of the rules which highlights key details and rules which must be followed. In addition to reading these rules, it is highly recommended to watch the [official submission guide](https://youtu.be/z2n2fCV1GY0) when submitting runs.**

# **Important Reminders**

**The F3 screen must be shown in the video of the run for all runs.**

- You still need to show F3 after the run is over even if you don’t use it in the run. (such as No F3 categories)
- When you show the F3 screen, make sure all parts are legible and unobscured.

**All runs must be submitted with a video.**

- The video must be permanent and viewable. (no Twitch VODs or private videos)

**You must include the world seed in your submission description.**

**Runs must include a video that shows all screens of creating the world, followed by the loading square.**

- For vanilla runs, you must show the World List and Create New World screens. If the run is set seed, you must also show the Seed Input screen.
- For runs that use the Atum mod, the video must show part of the prior run and the world generation loading square. 
- If you are using the mods Atum and SpeedrunIGT, and the SpeedrunIGT timer is visible upon the run’s start, and the F3 screen is opened and visible before exiting the world, the video does not need to include any world generation.

**Recreate is banned in versions 1.16+ for set seed runs.**

# **Mod Rules**

**Fabric API is banned.**

- This is a separate .jar file and not the Fabric Loader itself.

**Optifine is banned for 1.15+.**

- If you choose to use Optifine in pre-1.15, you may only do so with particular settings. These settings can be found in [A.8.1](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L687) of the full rules. 

**Fabric Loader is the only allowed mod loader. Do not use Forge or anything else.**

**There are only a few mods that you are allowed to use, which can be found here ([https://mods.tildejustin.dev/](https://mods.tildejustin.dev/)).**

- We recommend using SpeedrunIGT for ease of verification.

# **General Speedrun Rules**

**Keep the default settings of world generation.**

- You can only change the world name, difficulty (except for Peaceful), or choosing hardcore instead of survival.

**Do not edit the game’s files.**

- However, in the options.txt file, gamma may be edited up to 5.0.
- A launcher which has been verified to leave the game unmodified must be used. This includes:
  - The vanilla Minecraft launcher
  - MultiMC
  - Prism Launcher

**Do not use commands during the run.**

**Do not use Peaceful difficulty during the run.**

**The way runs are timed is either by world load or by first input, depending upon the category.**

**Runs must not intend to be as slow as possible (no “slowruns”).**

# **Submission Rules**

**Mark your run as F3 if it uses the F3 screen during the run, or any feature which is triggered by an F3 hotkey (such as F3+B hitboxes, F3+H advanced tooltips or F3+Esc pausing).**

**Mark your run’s difficulty as the lowest difficulty played during the run.**

**Mark the mods section of your run in accordance with the mods you used at any point during the run.**

- If no mods are used, choose Vanilla.
- If just Optifine (not Optifabric) is used, choose Optifine.
- If anything else (including Optifabric, Fabric Loader) is used, choose Modded.

# **Resource Pack Rules**

**You are only allowed to use a few resource packs. If you want to be safe, just use the vanilla resource pack.**

- You can use any vanilla resource packs, including the default pack, Programmer Art, and High Contrast packs.
- Detailed resource pack rules can be found in section A.4 of the full rules.
- If you use a non-vanilla resource pack, include a link to it in the speedrun.com run’s description.

# **Additional Proof**

**When submitting additional proof, please use the official Google form (**[https://forms.gle/v7oPXfjfi7553jkp7](https://forms.gle/v7oPXfjfi7553jkp7)**).**

**Additional proof is only required for achieving certain times in certain categories (see category rules to see if you need to). Regardless, when submitting a run, you agree to provide extra proof if asked by moderators. Refusal may lead to rejection.**

**If you are unsure how to submit certain pieces of additional proof, please follow the [tutorial](https://youtu.be/z2n2fCV1GY0) on submitting additional proof.**

# **External Tool Rules**

**SeedQueue, a mod that simulates multi-instance, where multiple instances of Minecraft are used to reset faster, is recommended in versions where it is available.**

- If you want to use multiple instances, such as in versions where SeedQueue is not available, please read the detailed multiple instance rules in section A.9 of the full rules.

**If you open multiple instances of Minecraft, they must each be in unique directories (separate .minecraft folders).**

**Do not use any macros in-game except for resize macros.**

- Any macros which change the screen size to within the monitor bounds may be used.
- Only one macro may make the game window larger than the monitor size, like a zoom macro for measuring Eyes of Ender. (intended to replace above rule)

**You may remap keys using external programs (like AutoHotkey), but it must be a one-to-one remap.**

- For instance, Shift+F3 cannot be rebound to a singular key.
- You may not rebind anything to the scrolling action of the scroll wheel.

**Physical reference sheets may be used, as well as four-function calculators. A reference sheet of any size not based on F3 information may be used.**

- For instance, stronghold ring locations, sheets/graphs of structure regions, and villager trading tables may be used.

**Other reference sheets and external tools must be specifically approved to be used as listed in [A.11.6 and A.11.7](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L827) of the full rules.**

**Specifically approved external tools may be used, as listed in [A.11.7](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L835) of the full rules. All other external tools may not be used.**

- Ninjabrain Bot for measuring Eyes of Ender is allowed.

# **Random Seed Rules**

**You are required to use a random seed (leave the seed input box blank).**

**You may not learn the seed during the run.**

- Do not do /seed until the run is over.
- Do not attempt to crack the world seed.
- After the run you should do /seed in order to include the seed in your run submission.
- Do not use F3 in pre-1.3 (it shows the seed).

# **Set Seed Rules**

**Recreate is banned in versions 1.16+.**

**You are required to set a world seed.**

# **Glitchless Rules**

**Do not save and quit or leave the game during the run.**

- You can save and quit accidentally or to resolve a bug. See the detailed rules on using Save and Quit in glitchless runs to see under what conditions it is allowed in D.1.3 of the full rules.

**A few additional techniques can be used in glitchless runs.**

- These include double-eating and Eliotex sprinting. See the detailed rules on what techniques are and aren’t allowed for glitchless runs in D.1.1 and D.1.2 of the full rules.

**SSG and RSG stand for “Set Seed Glitchless” and “Random Seed Glitchless” respectively, so they must follow the rules above.**

# **Glitched Rules**

**Glitched runs must use at least one glitch.**

- In External categories, you may Save and Quit and crash the game.

**It is highly recommended to use SpeedrunIGT in glitched categories, going to Timer, and setting the Autosave Interval to Ticks.**

**All gameplay segments are timed in glitched runs.**

**Any categories without the word “Glitchless” are glitched. This includes Any%, SS, and RS.**

# **Co-op Rules**

**Use either a dedicated** **server or Open to LAN.**

**Your server cannot use any mods that are banned, even if there are no plugins.**

- Do not use Paper, Spigot, CraftBukkit, or Bungeecord.

**You can use /difficulty to change the difficulty.**

- Do not change the difficulty in options, as it will enable peaceful momentarily.
- You must enable cheats to do this.

**If all players wait until everyone has joined, one person can do /time set 0, which will start the run’s timer.**

- You must enable cheats to do this.
- Do not use /time set 0 more than once.

**The first person to join the server, the person to complete the run, and anyone with cheats enabled must record their perspectives. When submitting your run, include these videos in the speedrun.com run description.**

- It is helpful to have all players submit a video, but only the ones above are required to.

**If more than 16 players are running, choose 16 players while submitting, input the names of 15 of the players, and then list “+others” for the 16th slot. Include the name of all other players not listed in the description of the speedrun.com submission.**

# **Structures/No Structures Rules**

**A structure is anything that requires Generate Structures: On to generate. (such as a Village, Nether Fortress, Mineshaft).**

- Dungeons are also considered a structure.
- See the full list of structures in [G.1.1](https://github.com/Minecraft-Java-Edition-Speedrunning/rules/blob/132b6ffbbca78414626587b3f0d0331a3a04365e/rules.md?plain=1#L1081) of the full rules.

**A category marked ‘Structures’ must use at least one structure.**

**A category marked ‘No Structures’ cannot use any structures.**

- You may choose Generate Structures: Off, or keep them on but do not interact with them.

- The first 5 seconds of each settings change pause are not timed.
- Pauses directly after an initial load into a given location are not timed.
